svg.text: Food-ordering platform · PostgreSQL database steward_db (9 tables) + MongoDB collection reviews. Read every line as a sentence, e.g. “A USER places zero or many ORDERS”.
foreign key (→ table it points to)
• ORDER_ITEMS is the junction table: an ORDER has many DISHES, a DISH appears in many ORDERS.
• Name & price are copied into ORDER_ITEMS so old orders stay correct if the menu changes.
• INVENTORY_RESERVATIONS.order_id has no foreign key: orders belong to another service.
